summary: Sultan Kudarat 2nd District representative with about 94 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant record: criminalizing non-consensual AI face and likeness, tax incentives for pro bono medical services, bank anti-corruption transparency and travel-tax abolition. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: No dimension has two distinct rubric issues. Extractor may under-report.
